Retaining Wall Ipswich Questions, Answered Clearly Start with the common planning questions, then confirm the requirements that apply to your wall and site. How much does a retaining wall cost in Ipswich? Most Ipswich retaining walls are priced by wall face area (height x length). Treated timber walls commonly start around $300-$450 per square metre, concrete sleeper walls around $550-$700 per square metre, and core-filled block or engineered walls from $550-$750+ per square metre. These figures are indicative only - they exclude GST, excavation, drainage, backfill, engineering and difficult access. A written project price should follow a site inspection. Do I need council approval for a retaining wall in Ipswich? Ipswich City Council requires building approval when any of the following apply: the wall plus retained fill/cut is more than 1.0 m above natural ground level; the wall supports a surcharge load such as a driveway, building, pool or another wall; the wall is within 1.5 m of a building or another retaining wall; or it forms part of a pool barrier. A wall is exempt only if it clears all of these conditions. Always confirm your specific site with council or a private certifier before work begins. What is the cheapest retaining wall material? Treated pine timber sleepers are generally the lowest upfront cost for low, non-structural garden walls. They suit walls under 1.0 m with no surcharge and good drainage. For taller walls, driveways or engineered applications, concrete sleepers or core-filled block usually deliver lower lifetime cost because they resist rot, termites and the heavy reactive clay movement common in Ipswich. How long does a retaining wall last? Treated timber walls typically last 10-15 years in Ipswich's reactive clay before rot or termite damage becomes a concern.
